g.text: Tonal, envelope, and stereo diagnostics · 48 kHz stereo
Verified CC0 Commons recordings; instrumentation/capture technique is not independently established.
Identical resampled, delay-aligned passages. RMS matching is not LUFS matching. Numerical difference is not a quality score.
Envelope ratios include level change. Crest factor is level invariant. Whole-source correlation does not fully describe stereo imaging.
